radiusSource: Radius 64.079 (58.285 to 71.273) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 44,579,517 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.765 (1.725 to 1.805) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3613 +/- 27.5 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4081339303496353152: teff_gspphot 3613.032 K (16th-84th percentiles 3581.3313-3636.3853), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4081339303496353152: teff_gspphot 3613.032 K (16th-84th percentiles 3581.3313-3636.3853), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
